## Architecture (SlideRule)

reference = a source-level type reference; use = a source-level member access. Expand any rule ID with `sliderule explain <rule-id>` for its reason and fix.

### Layers
- **Domain** — `Meridian.Quoting.Domain.*`. Domain holds the quote and rate-card model.
- **Application** — `Meridian.Quoting.Application.*`. Application holds the use cases and the ports they depend on.
- **Infrastructure** — `Meridian.Quoting.Infrastructure.*`. Infrastructure implements the ports: in-memory persistence and the system clock.
- **Api** — `Meridian.Quoting.Api.*`. Api is the composition root and the HTTP surface.

### Rules
- `layering/domain-independent` — The Domain layer must not reference the Application layer, the Infrastructure layer or the Api layer.
- `layering/application-boundaries` — The Application layer must reference only the Domain layer (external packages are not constrained by this rule).
- `naming/interfaces` — Interfaces in `Meridian.Quoting.*` must be named `I*`. See <https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/standard/design-guidelines/names-of-classes-structs-and-interfaces>.
- `naming/controllers` — Types in `Meridian.Quoting.Api.Controllers.*` must be named `*Controller`.
- `handlers/naming` — Types implementing `IHandler` must be named `*Handler`.
- `handlers/transactional` — Types implementing `ICommandHandler<TCommand>` must be attributed with `[Transactional]`.
- `persistence/repository-ports` — Interfaces named `*Repository` must reside in `Meridian.Quoting.Domain.*`.
- `messaging/immutable-messages` — Types in `Meridian.Quoting.Application.Messages.*` must be records.
- `time/injected-clock` — Types in `Meridian.Quoting.*`, except types named `SystemClock`, must not use `DateTime.Now` or `DateTime.UtcNow`.
